_note: Which model does which job. Every agent runs on claude-haiku-5-5, the current Haiku (decided 2026-11-17 by a principal, for cost: $0.10 / $0.50 per million tokens for prompts up to 100K tokens, $0.50 / $2.50 above). Effort is the quality lever: research, drafting and call prep run at high; raise to xhigh before moving a job up a tier. If research findings or drafts come back thin, change that job's model to claude-sonnet-5-5 (add "fallbacks": "default" with it) or claude-opus-5-5. Claude Haiku has no server-side refusal fallback, so no Haiku job sets fallbacks; a declined request is reported as a refusal. Research on Haiku uses the basic web search and fetch tools (src/model.mjs picks them by model). Structuring, auditing and reply sorting are sorting jobs at low effort; call extraction (E15-S2) at medium. Prices are dollars per million tokens (API reference, cached 2026-11-03) and cover tokens only: web search carries its own per-search fee that these figures do not include [verify]. The caps are per account and are placeholders until the first measured run. Each is a principal's decision.
